evaluation_semantics: Method-independent per-voxel attainable spherical-mean data-fit bound, with physical range and derived-field consistency; replaces parameter-reference similarity.
objective_definition: For each supported voxel mean over all positive-b directional squared residuals / observed b0 squared. Within-shell variance cancels in prediction-minus-baseline difference. Every voxel must satisfy the bound. Baseline is an attainable fit, not truth.
